headline: "Kambar-Ata-2" is not operating at full capacity due to electricity grid restrictions
summary: The Kambarata-2 hydropower plant in Kyrgyzstan cannot use its full installed capacity because of limits on power transmission lines. Of the first stage's 120 megawatts, output is constrained.
why: Hydropower output depends on grid transmission capacity, and constraints reduce the revenue and energy supply that large generation projects can deliver. Kyrgyzstan relies on hydropower for much of its electricity.
original_headline: «Камбар-Ата-2» не работает на полную мощность из-за ограничений электросетей
